events.title: Mitsubishi Electric GX Works3 and Motion Control Setting
events.summary: A local attacker can authenticate with an invalid block password and modify executable modules in memory on Mitsubishi Electric GX Works3 and Motion Control Setting software, potentially allowing tampering with control programs. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-15688 and is rated critical with a CVSS score of 9.2.
events.why_it_matters: Defenders should be aware that the vulnerability has a high severity score of 9.2, indicating a significant risk if exploited. The advisory is new and has not been listed in KEV. No evidence of exploitation in the wild is provided.

claims.text: CVE-2026-15688 is rated 9.2 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-15688 being exploited in the next 30 days at under 1%.
